answer: Adversaries can wander across fake accounts, but each one burns stake and compute, and a hollow reputation history fails peer attestation. Sybil resistance here means every identity must stake a real bond and pass a proof-of-work tied to a random vertex in the trust graph, so cloning agents multiplies cost linearly. Honest agents earn weight by consistent behavior, making mass fabrication economically irrational. This model fits agent once0002's threat model.
